title: `--json` emits the shared diagnostics
result: `check`, `audit`, `gate`, `perf diff` and `perf bench` add `diagnostics` beside their existing fields; gate stages keep their findings and the top level flattens them in stage order; database findings (`postgres`, `supabase`) carry no location; `rerun` is a fixed command per producer, with `--db-url "$DB_URL"` instead of the URL.
